acceptance_criteria.statement: Quality status distinguishes covered, not_run, failed, stale, missing, and excluded states.
A passed run is not current when its test revision changes, referenced evidence is no longer current, an evidence code reference is stale, or the source repository differs.
Completing a work item does not make its criterion delivery-ready without a current passing verification or integrated immutable evidence.

content.statement: As a product manager deciding whether work is ready, I can distinguish current passing evidence from failed, missing, excluded, or stale evidence so progress is not mistaken for delivery proof.
content.title: Trust current criterion evidence

state.reason: Retired as duplicate: criterion-quality-readiness owns evidence state and current proof outcomes, while track-work-delivery:done-is-not-delivery owns the progress-versus-delivery boundary.
